binding_interpretation.DR-007: Prepare a live next attacker before a non-terminal trade when the opponent can answer or strand the active; this is a hypothesis to isolate, not an executable effect rule.
binding_interpretation.DR-008: Preserve a backup when the route needs multiple future attacks, subject to deck-specific opportunity cost; the backup count must be public, route-compatible, and not hidden-card inferred.
binding_interpretation.DR-016: Attach for the next attack rather than a doomed active when the future attacker is below threshold; only explicit current attach deltas may be used at PolicyV1 runtime.
binding_interpretation.STR-003: Treat next usable attacker plus its resource threshold as a prerequisite for a non-terminal trade.
binding_interpretation.SF-004: Use binary readiness plus distance-to-threshold rather than a raw attacker count.
binding_interpretation.SF-005: Measure count and quality of visible route-compatible backups; a raw count alone is insufficient.
binding_interpretation.CON-001: Continuity must not be blended into immediate-Prize value. The fixtures deliberately expose the trade between readiness and chain robustness.
binding_interpretation.CON-004: Semantic option identity is authoritative. All variant comparisons require permutation controls; raw option order is never a feature.
binding_interpretation.RQ-004: The exact Mega Abomasnow route and first-attacker choice remain open; B2 supplies continuity diagnostics, not a route claim.
binding_interpretation.RQ-005: The isolated held-out CABT ablation of readiness/backup features remains open and is the later WDL experiment.
binding_interpretation.RQ-006: Option-order predictiveness remains unresolved; the B2 contract forbids using it.
binding_interpretation.RQ-007: Card/evolution/attack interactions require exact native capsules; static card prose is not enough.

knowledge_base.design_conclusion: The KB supports two isolated, falsifiable continuity hypotheses. It does not authorize an assumption that any Mega Abomasnow variable attack, Trainer effect, or hidden card is known at runtime.

policy_v1_allowed: Current EngineObservationV1 and current SelectionRequestV1 only.
Public own Active/Bench entities, visible own hand/discard/looking cards exposed by the adapter, public counts, statuses, attached energy types/counts, and public event fields.

current_action_delta_rule.attach: For a current MAIN ATTACH option, apply only the explicitly qualified local delta of one legal current manual Energy attachment to the resolved public target. Do not read a successor to discover whether it succeeded.
current_action_delta_rule.evolve: For a current MAIN EVOLVE option, apply only a sealed local 722-to-723 or other exact candidate evolution capsule. Unknown evolution target, status, or effect delegates.
current_action_delta_rule.play_or_search: PLAY, CARD, CARD_OR_ATTACHED_CARD, ABILITY, RETREAT, ATTACK, and all follow-up effect requests delegate unless a future capsule explicitly supplies a complete current local delta. A play that might later bench a card is not treated as a ready attacker now.
current_action_delta_rule.status_and_legality: A candidate is ready only when the qualified attack capability, visible entity, required energy matching, evolution/status constraints, and current legal-action contract are all known. Unknown is not ready and does not become a favorable estimate.

terminal_and_compound_rules.terminal_first: Terminal result is checked before selection-local fields; PolicyV1 is never called for a terminal selection. A current attack is not called an immediate win merely because a static damage predicate crosses HP.
terminal_and_compound_rules.complete_options: Every available legal option in the request must be covered. A safe prefix is not scored while an unsupported alternative is ignored.
terminal_and_compound_rules.compound: Activation is limited to min_count=max_count=1, or min_count=0/max_count=1 with an explicitly legal semantic STOP. max_count>1, ordered multi-select, and unresolved STOP contracts delegate to B0.
terminal_and_compound_rules.tie: Distinct non-equivalent options with equal formulation keys return AMBIGUOUS and delegate. A canonical semantic fingerprint may resolve only exact semantic duplicates after the strategic key is unequal or equivalence is proven.
terminal_and_compound_rules.delegation: B0_DELEGATE is experimental abstention to the frozen public control, not a final-adapter fallback. It must have a separate counter and must never be reported as a continuity selection.

attacker_capability_record.energy_rule: Use a versioned energy-matching function bound to CardTableV1 and the native capsule. For this deck, card 3 is Water type 3; do not infer general colorless matching from prose.

candidate_sets.next_attacker: Visible own Bench entities with at least one runtime-qualified attack capability; a visible own-hand card is accessible but not ready, and a hidden deck/Prize slot is never a candidate.
candidate_sets.backup_attacker: Visible own Bench entities distinct from the current Active that are already ready under the same qualified capability contract. A card in hand or a hidden copy cannot count as a backup.
candidate_sets.near_ready: A visible Bench candidate with all non-energy requirements satisfied and exactly one energy unit short of a qualified attack after the local current-action delta. If the energy matching or evolution/status condition is unknown, near_ready is UNKNOWN rather than zero.
candidate_sets.active: The current Active may be recorded for context and current-attack readiness but is excluded from backup count. Attaching to Active does not create a backup.

action_local_values.ready_after: Number of visible qualified next/backup candidates satisfying all requirements after applying only the selected local delta.
action_local_values.best_deficit_after: Minimum known nonnegative energy deficit among qualified visible Bench candidates after the selected local delta; UNKNOWN if no qualified candidate or any required capability is unresolved.
action_local_values.two_backup_tail_after: For at least two qualified visible Bench candidates, sort their known nonnegative deficits ascending and return the second-smallest deficit. This is the one-loss chain-tail proxy; UNKNOWN when fewer than two candidates or an unresolved required field exists.
action_local_values.unresolved_count: Count of candidate feature fields that are unknown or depend on a PARTIAL capsule. It is diagnostic and a fail-closed reason, not a favorable score.
action_local_values.no_successor_claim: All *_after values are virtual local-delta values. They are not observed post-action state and cannot establish that the attack or evolution actually executed.

formulations.name: Next-attacker threshold first
formulations.falsifiable_hypothesis: When one complete current attach/evolve option crosses a visible qualified future-attacker threshold and competing options do not, this arm selects that option independent of option order. It should differ from B2-B on a balanced-chain fixture where threshold crossing concentrates the chain.
decision_key: current terminal override is evaluator-only and never a PolicyV1 action
canonical semantic action key only after the strategic prefix; non-equivalent ties are AMBIGUOUS

feature_use.next_attacker_ready_after: Binary/ count threshold for the best visible Bench follow-up after the current local delta; it does not use hidden deck copies or a future response.
feature_use.best_deficit_after: Minimum exact energy deficit among qualified visible future attackers; not an estimated draw probability.
feature_use.backup_ready_count_after: Count of ready visible Bench attackers after the local delta; no quality multiplier or blended score.

expected_fixture_behavior.reason: The option attaches one Water Energy to a 723 with one of two required Water units, producing best_deficit=0 and one ready backup.

formulations.name: Two-attacker chain-tail robustness
formulations.falsifiable_hypothesis: When options trade an immediately ready single backup for a lower second-smallest deficit across two future attackers, this arm selects the lower two-attacker tail. It must preserve semantic/permutation invariance and can select an option that B2-A rejects because it does not immediately cross a threshold.
decision_key: current terminal override is evaluator-only and never a PolicyV1 action
canonical semantic action key only after the strategic prefix; non-equivalent ties are AMBIGUOUS

feature_use.two_backup_tail_after: The second-smallest visible qualified Bench energy deficit after the local delta; it encodes a one-loss chain tail without assigning hidden response probabilities.
feature_use.backup_ready_count_after: A secondary guard prevents the tail proxy from preferring an option with no ready backup when a same-tail option has one.
feature_use.no_blended_score: The key is lexicographic and names each feature; no arbitrary weighted sum or aggregate gold score is introduced.

expected_fixture_behavior.reason: Attaching to the zero-energy 723 yields backup deficits [1,1,3], with two-attacker tail=1, versus [0,2,3] when attaching to p0:s11.

fail_closed: fewer than two qualified visible Bench candidates

fixture_contract.fixture_schema: Every fixture must materialize as a valid G1 EngineObservationV1 plus SelectionRequestV1. Dataclass defaults may fill only optional fields; required option fields, canonical known-entity metadata_ref values, source/target references, semantic fingerprints, request identity, and all option/request enum fields must be present or deterministically derived from the fixture before PublicStateV1 validation. The semantic_target field is a fixture assertion and must be stripped before constructing LegalOptionV1. A shorthand fixture row is not a legal runtime input.
fixture_contract.fixture_metadata_rule: The attack capability rows in these fixtures are FIXTURE_ONLY unless their qualification_id is replaced by a sealed native capsule. Fixture pass proves arithmetic, boundary, and divergence behavior only; it cannot qualify native semantics or policy strength. Fixture-only capability rows must still carry the complete capability-record shape; shorthand required_water alone is not accepted by the evaluator.

common_public_state.hidden_opponent_state: No opponent card identities are present; hidden counts remain the player-view counts only.

mutations: Change min_count/max_count to 1/2 or ordering to ORDERED.
Change min_count/max_count to 0/1. STOP is not a LegalOptionV1 row; it is legal only through the G1 CompoundActionBuilder mask when min_count=0 and max_count>0.
fixture_cases.expected: The 1/2 and ORDERED requests delegate. The optional singleton may emit a real STOP only when the G1 legality mask allows it and the formulation has no covered positive continuity action; the decoder trace retains the STOP token. Empty output is never an implicit STOP.

active_request_classes: MAIN selection_type=0, selection_context=0, ordering=UNORDERED, context_card_id/effect_card_id null, with only qualified ATTACH option_type=8 singleton alternatives; every ATTACH source must be a visible own Basic Water card in HAND, every target must be a visible own Active/Bench entity, and energy_attached=false.

MAIN selection_type=0, selection_context=0, ordering=UNORDERED, context_card_id/effect_card_id null, with only qualified EVOLVE option_type=9 singleton alternatives after a sealed exact evolution capsule; every source and target must resolve to the current public snapshot.
Optional singleton 0..1 with no STOP option row: G1's explicit STOP token is legal only when the request bounds permit it, subject to the same complete-option and no-positive-action rule.
always_delegate_currently: Any request containing 1047, 1044, 1045, an unresolved evolution capability, or another PARTIAL/UNKNOWN capability. Route-bounded evidence for 1042, 1043, 1046, and Surfing Beach 1262 may not activate B2 until the complete capability, target/status/evolution constraints, and current local-delta contract are independently bound; otherwise delegate.
PLAY/search/effect chains whose future bench/evolution/energy result is not an explicit current local delta.
CARD, ATTACHED_CARD, CARD_OR_ATTACHED_CARD, ENERGY, SKILL, ABILITY, RETREAT, ATTACK, COUNT, YES_NO, SPECIAL_CONDITION, and unresolved setup requests.
Any max_count>1 or ORDERED compound request, any incomplete option set, duplicate semantic fingerprint, unsupported enum/field, stale lifecycle identity, or missing public entity.
Any formulation feature that is UNKNOWN, uses a hidden identity, or needs a successor/response/terminal value.

mapping.SELECTED: Return a CompoundActionV1 built through the existing action builder and final boundary validator; record authority=EXPERIMENTAL_CONTINUITY.
mapping.B0_DELEGATE: Invoke the frozen public B0 control through a separately identified delegation path; count delegation, not fallback.
mapping.AMBIGUOUS: Do not use option order; delegate to B0 and retain the tied semantic keys.
mapping.UNSUPPORTED: Delegate to B0 with a compact reason capsule.
mapping.NO_SAFE_CONTINUITY: Delegate to B0; this does not mean a submission fallback was used.
mapping.TERMINAL_OVERRIDE: Evaluator/harness-only status after terminal-first processing; never emitted as a current PolicyV1 selection.

diagnostics.interpretation_guard: Diagnostics describe activation and behavior. They do not prove WDL improvement, route completion, terminal wins, or card-effect semantics.

comparison_contract.estimand: For each formulation, anchor, candidate seat, and natural-deployment stratum, estimate candidate-perspective terminal WDL score (wins + 0.5*draws) / completed_games against the named frozen anchor; the aggregate is descriptive across the preregistered cells only.
comparison_contract.sampling: Candidate and frozen-control arms are independent native game samples. Do not pair games, claim paired seeds, reuse a trajectory, or treat option permutations as independent games.

uncertainty.per_cell_wdl: Report wins, draws, losses, completed/requested games, and a 95% Wilson interval for the candidate score in every anchor x candidate-seat cell.
uncertainty.candidate_control_delta: Report the observed candidate-minus-control score delta and a 10,000-resample independent two-sample bootstrap percentile interval using game-level terminal scores within each arm; preserve the bootstrap seed and raw score vectors.
uncertainty.activation: Report activation/selection/delegation counts and exact denominators separately; no activation rate is a WDL substitute.

comparison_contract.target_cell_rule: Before Stage 4, name the target anchor/seat cells and formulation in the immutable run plan. A targeted signal means the independent-bootstrap 95% lower percentile for candidate-minus-control is greater than zero in at least one named target cell, with all requested games complete and all reliability counters zero. This is an experiment continuation criterion, not a promotion claim.
comparison_contract.incomplete_or_invalid: Any incomplete game, invalid action, fallback, stale request, timeout, crash, missing output, permutation failure, nonfinite metric, or provenance mismatch blocks that arm; do not score incomplete games or silently replace them.
comparison_contract.no_blended_score: Do not average activation, runtime, route diagnostics, or matchup cells into a blended gold score. Runtime and reliability are eligibility gates; terminal WDL is the only primary effectiveness metric.

shared_provenance.exact_deck_and_asset_receipts: Reuse B0 config hashes, but hash the actual loaded engine, wrapper, card data, candidate source/config, and each native anchor/deck.

stage_1_mechanical_canary.promotion_from_stage: No promotion or strength claim. A pass only establishes mechanical reliability and independently reviewed diagnostic integrity.

stage_2_local_screen.prerequisite: Stage 1 independently reviewed PASS for the relevant arm.
stage_2_local_screen.seat_and_anchor_matrix: Four anchors x four candidate games per seat per arm, natural deployment.
stage_2_local_screen.analysis: Report activation and candidate-perspective WDL per anchor/seat; retain continuity decision traces and compare each variant separately to its independently sampled control. Use the comparison_contract uncertainty rules. No blended component score.

stage_3_private_kaggle_cpu_screen.prerequisite: Stage 2 zero-reliability review plus technical approval of exact notebook/config and private artifact destination.
stage_3_private_kaggle_cpu_screen.launch: Private bounded Kaggle CPU only; no submission and no GPU/training.
stage_3_private_kaggle_cpu_screen.review: Independent raw-manifest and candidate-perspective recalculation required before any confirmation.

stage_4_confirmation.prerequisite: A preregistered arm shows fixture-consistent behavior, zero reliability defects, and the comparison_contract target-cell rule passes without an unexplained anchor/seat regression.
stage_4_confirmation.metric: Candidate-perspective (wins + 0.5*draws)/completed_games with Wilson/bootstrap uncertainty, per anchor and seat; never a blended gold score.
stage_4_confirmation.promotion_rule: Only after independent review, zero tolerance counters, preserved off-target behavior or the predeclared target-cell rule, no unexplained catastrophic matchup regression, and a scaled held-out confirmation. This report does not promote either formulation.

runtime_budget_prerequisites.policy_shape: Current-only O(number of public entities x qualified capability records); no search, successor simulation, belief sampling, or network.

pre_registered_candidate_limits.conservative_process_envelope: At most the conservative competition envelope of approximately 1.6 vCPU and 8 GiB; no GPU at inference.

runtime_budget_prerequisites.measurement_rule: Measure candidate-only callback time and CPU/RSS from the actual run. A delegation to B0 is not allowed to hide a slow continuity calculation; count both paths separately.
budget_blockers: No implementation exists yet to measure these limits.
No native run may start until the exact import specs, source/config hashes, clean candidate dependency scan, and resolved B0-compatible config are reviewed.
If a future formulation requires compound search or successor simulation, it is a new experiment and cannot reuse this budget.
